english.title: Controller / manager fail to prevent smoking in smoke-free premises - Health Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who controlled or was concerned in the management of smoke-free premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), failed to cause a person smoking there to stop smoking
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(1), (4) and (7) of the Health Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 8(2) of the Health Act 2006 provides an exception to the offence for performers.
(ii) Section 8(5) of the Act provides defences to the offence.
